text: Although, I will say one thing, there is a lot of noise pollution.

text: Noise pollution is a term that refers to like the sounds of a city.
ipa: /nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən ˈɪz ə tˈɝm ðˈæt ɹəfˈɝz tˈu lˈaɪk ðə sˈaʊndz ˈʌv ə sˈɪti/

text: It's honking, like you hear all that honking, the sounds of vehicles,

ipa: /ðə sˈaʊndz ˈʌv pˈipəl wˈɝkɪŋ nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən/

text: There is a lot of noise pollution that you have to get used to.
ipa: /ðˈɛɹ ˈɪz ə lˈɑt ˈʌv nˈɔɪz pəlˈuʃən ðˈæt jˈu hˈæv tˈu ɡˈɛt jˈuzd tˈu/

text: And in Vietnam, people park their scooters everywhere.
